authorship: Hand-authored command envelope witnesses over docs/X1_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT.md sections 3-4 and 8. No production transport code exists or was consulted.

expected.law: A request ID must be a positive safe integer strictly greater than every previously submitted ID, including refused ones.

cases.title: Zero and negative request IDs refuse

expected.law: Nonpositive, fractional, and unsafe-integer IDs refuse before any state read.
The 33rd concurrent submission refuses without perturbing the queued 32 or the running transition.
Tick interval must be 10-100 ms, lookahead 0.05-0.2 s, and lookahead strictly greater than one tick interval; the final row fails only the strict inequality.

cases.title: Initialization requires a valid trusted gesture
cases.scenario: The gesture sequence equals the last accepted gesture sequence.

expected.law: Gesture sequences are strictly increasing positive safe integers; replayed receipts refuse.
startBeat is inclusive at both ends of [0, totalBeats]; one exact tick past the end refuses. Playing from exactly totalBeats publishes an immediate natural end.
Seek retires the epoch, sets the exact target beat, and republishes the prior status; out-of-range targets refuse without retiring anything.

cases.title: Tempo binding requires a strictly newer plan revision
cases.scenario: Binding carries the same documentId and an equal planRevision.

expected.law: A tempo change is a document edit: same documentId, strictly greater planRevision. Equal or older revisions refuse.

cases.title: Tempo bounds come from the plan

expected.law: The bound plan's tempoBpm must lie in the domain 20-400 range; the transport revalidates rather than trusting the compiler.

cases.title: Loop binding keeps the plan revision
cases.scenario: Binding carries a strictly greater planRevision.

expected.law: Loop is ephemeral transport state, not document data: same documentId, same planRevision. A revision change must travel through set-tempo or replace-plan.
Empty, reversed, and out-of-range loops refuse; the embedded plan loop must equal the declared range exactly.
Only the nine exact domain instrument IDs are accepted; case variants and legacy sample names refuse.
Preview IDs use the reserved x1:preview: prefix with a nonempty X0-legal suffix; pitches are 1-16 integers 0-127; the gate is X0-legal.

cases.title: New preview releases the previous preview first
cases.scenario: Preview B starts while preview A sounds.

expected.law: Exactly one preview owner may be nonreleasing; the X0 preview-release ramp retires A before B's first attack; the progression epoch is untouched.

cases.title: Release of an unknown preview refuses
cases.scenario: release-preview names x1:preview:missing while no such preview is owned.

expected.law: Releasing a preview the transport does not own refuses; it never falls through to a broader X0 selector.

cases.title: Engine refusal is carried, not swallowed
cases.scenario: X0 refuses an attack batch with audio.retiring_voice_capacity during a play epoch.

expected.law: The transport surfaces the exact X0 code in engineRefusalCode; it never retries silently, drops the event, or reclassifies the cause.
Enabled flags are runtime-validated booleans even where TypeScript narrows them.

cases.title: Replace-plan binding validity
cases.scenario: The binding's plan carries sourceDocumentId d1 while the binding declares documentId d2.

expected.law: The binding documentId must equal the plan's sourceDocumentId; replacement cannot smuggle a plan compiled from a different document.

cases.title: Structural plan validation precedes binding checks
cases.scenario: The plan reports totalBeats smaller than its final event end.

expected.law: Schema, compiler version, event ordering, and exact-total consistency refuse as plan_invalid before plan_mismatch or range checks run, matching the frozen precedence.

cases.title: Command serialization under interleaving
cases.scenario: play, pause, and stop are submitted in one synchronous burst.

expected.law: Strict FIFO admission: each transition, including awaited X0 receipts, completes before the next begins. This is the L-AUDIO-04 race regression witness.
